accumulation_model_density_source: STOCK-CALIBRATED composite enrolment-and-payment factor delta in (0,1]: credited contribution years = delta x the cohort's age-implied potential years, calibrated by bisection so modelled 2025 assets equal MAPAS's reported aggregate. pw_monthly_age75_f_source: programmed withdrawal per the payout law art. 16(4)-(6): monthly = balance / (a_x x 12), where a_x is the annuity-IMMEDIATE annual factor sum_k v^k kp_x, recalculated every 12 months on the new balance and age. Mortality basis: the OFFICIAL DZS period life table 2023 (data/clean/lifetables_period.csv), which is what the MAPAS bylaw Сл. весник 177/2022 art. 2 prescribes for pension companies -- NOT this paper's projected table. Interest: a real 2.0%, the highest published basis that does not exceed the cap the interest-rate bylaw implies (2.18%). Roll-forward assumes the fund earns exactly the assumed real return and the table and rate are unchanged, so the decline shown is the pure no-pooling effect, not a market forecast; payment in the year the member turns 75, if alive

validation_residual_note: The model's zero for 2026-2028 is contradicted by the data. MAPAS's 2025 report records 51 members beginning an old-age second-pillar pension in 2025 and 116 in payment during the year, every one of them at least 62 and therefore born before about 1964 -- exactly the pre-1967 group this model sets to zero. The pre-1967 residue of continuation declarations is real; it is simply below the resolution of Chart 5.3 (a bar under about 481 members is invisible). Carrying the observed flow forward through the last year a pre-1967 cohort can reach a statutory age puts the missed present value at 144,137,268 MKD, 0.13% of the main figure (pv_balances_2026_2040_mkd) -- relevant to the claim, immaterial for the magnitude. What the model gets right is the shape: a near-zero flow at the statutory ages until the 1967 cohort arrives in 2029 (women) and 2031 (men), then a steep rise. Disability and survivor claims are not a residual inflow: the report states that on such a claim the account is transferred to the ПИОСМ Fund and the pension is paid from the first pillar, so the 91 disability and 263 survivor cases of 2025 are exits from the pillar.
